script.problem: It has 37 words. A meaning is about 30 words at most.

terra.problem: The meaning states that His family thought Jesus was not thinking clearly, but Gill also gives an interpretation in which they were worried about His health, not His mind. It should present this as a difference in interpretation.
“Deranged” and “His mind was disturbed” may be hard for a 10-year-old to understand.
